canonical_data: local working tree plus Markdown specs, steering files, hooks, and service-managed sessions
current_repo_note: Kiro's official GitHub repository is documentation and issue-tracking surface, not reusable operational source.
strengths: Specs and steering keep intent in reviewable project files
Hooks and powers support explicit repeatable automation
IDE, CLI, and MCP cover interactive and scripted workflows
weaknesses: Operational implementation is proprietary and governed by AWS service terms
Model and service processing limits local-only operation
why_it_matters: A distinct provider product that makes specifications and durable project guidance first-class coding-agent artifacts.
